consent.title: Analytics cookies
consent.description: Allow analytics cookies to help us understand site use. Continuing without cookies keeps analytics storage disabled, but Google may still receive cookieless measurement pings.

settings.title: Analytics
settings.description: Connect this site to a Google Analytics 4 property. Raw visitor events remain with the provider.
settings.ga4Description: Anonymous page views, application goals, aggregate reports, and realtime visitors.
settings.serviceAccountPlaceholder: Paste a dedicated Viewer service-account JSON credential
settings.secretHelp: The credential is write-only and encrypted with the key derived from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. It is never returned by the API.

credentialGuide.title: Issue Google Analytics 4 credentials
credentialGuide.description: Prepare the identifiers and a dedicated service account that PodoKit needs to collect events and read aggregate reports.
credentialGuide.propertyTitle: Create or select a GA4 property and web stream
credentialGuide.propertyDescription: In Analytics Admin, open Data streams and copy the web stream Measurement ID that starts with G-. Then open Property settings and copy the numeric Property ID.
credentialGuide.apiTitle: Enable the Google Analytics Data API
credentialGuide.apiDescription: Select or create a Google Cloud project, open the API Library, search for Google Analytics Data API, and enable it.
credentialGuide.accountDescription: In Google Cloud IAM & Admin, open Service Accounts and create an account for analytics reporting. Do not grant broad Google Cloud project roles.
credentialGuide.accessTitle: Grant Viewer access to the GA4 property
credentialGuide.accessDescription: Copy the service account email. In Analytics Admin, open Property access management, add that email, and assign the Viewer role.
credentialGuide.keyTitle: Create and download a JSON key
credentialGuide.keyDescription: Open the service account, select Keys, Add key, Create new key, and JSON. The file downloads only once. If key creation is blocked by an organization policy, ask your Google Cloud administrator.
credentialGuide.connectDescription: Paste the Measurement ID, Property ID, and the entire downloaded JSON here. Save, run Test connection, and enable analytics only after it succeeds. A new key may need about 60 seconds before the first successful request.
credentialGuide.securityDescription: This connector currently requires a long-lived JSON key. Use a dedicated Viewer account, never share or commit the file, and rotate or delete the key if it is exposed. PodoKit stores it encrypted and never reads it back into the browser.

settings.productionOnly: Collection runs only in production. Use Test connection to validate report access without enabling local tracking.
settings.connectionFailed: Could not verify the Google Analytics connection

dashboard.title: Analytics
dashboard.description: Aggregate traffic and goal data from this site's configured provider.
dashboard.unavailableHelp: Configure and verify Google Analytics, or try again after the provider recovers.
dashboard.empty: No analytics data for this period.
